correctness.rationale: For N=2^p the iterate T^p has one fixed point on each dyadic branch at j/(N-1) for even j and (j+1)/(N+1) for odd j. Primality means only periods 1 and p divide p; deleting 0 and 2/3 leaves N-2 points. Sorting surviving points and splitting before/after deletion index q=(2N-1)/3 gives four parity/rank inequalities bounding discrepancy by r=2/(N+1), attained just left of first point. Monotone equal-mass quantile coupling gives W_infinity=D*, while its preimages and endpoint zero prove exact covering. Upper/lower Lipschitz envelopes give minimax <=Lr; identical zero data of ±L dist(.,Pp) give >=Lr. Adjacent branch grid spacings and joined deleted neighbors give largest gap for odd p. p=2 checked explicitly. Exact Fraction independent calculations for primes 2,3,5,7,11 match, without inferring all-prime proof.
residual_risks: Composite periods and individual periodic orbits are outside scope.
